what: Cursor scout tier is planned to read diff paths through launch-review.sh, but the Cursor launcher only sets --workspace "$PWD" and has no extra read root for the scout output directory.
scenario_or_breakage: When Codex is unavailable or fails, Cursor can return a valid empty archetype manifest because it cannot read "$REVIEW_TMPDIR/diff.txt"; that valid empty result wins the waterfall and prevents Claude from running.
suggested_fix: Either add and test a Cursor read-root mechanism for the scout output directory, or keep SIMPLE by dropping Cursor from this scout waterfall until that support exists.
